einzeiler: Celebrating the season one finale with a look back at 50 episodes and behind-the-scenes…
kurzfassung: The hosts celebrate the end of the first season of their podcast after releasing 50 episodes. They share the origin story of how the show was pitched to and greenlit by Wondery. Finally, they thank their listeners and the production team for making the first season a success.
stichpunkte: Season one concludes after 50 episodes of business and pop culture stories
The podcast received a nomination for best business podcast from The Signal Awards
The origin story started years ago with research into the McDonald's Happy Meal
Wondery greenlit the show after a pitch in Los Angeles
The hosts highlight the focus on success stories rather than downfalls
Listenership reached an all-time high over the summer months
The hosts thank the production team, researchers, fact-checkers, and writers
Listeners are encouraged to check out the hosts' daily show, The Best One Yet

clips.hook: This show just got nominated for an award.
clips.text: The podcast receives a nomination in the best business podcast category from a major awards organization.

clips.hook: There's a fetish in Hollywood right now for downfall stories.
clips.text: Media production heavily favors narratives about failure rather than positive achievements.

clips.hook: We've recorded over 1,500 episodes of our daily show.
clips.text: The creators have built a massive catalog of daily content covering curated business news.

clips.hook: The fact-checkers and researchers found every juicy detail.
clips.text: Behind-the-scenes professionals worked diligently to ensure the accuracy and entertainment value of the narratives.

clips.hook: The untold origin stories of the products you're obsessed with.
clips.text: The series focuses on uncovering the hidden beginnings of famous consumer items and the individuals behind them.
